Cyber AI 

Built on our unique AI 
approach 

Rather than teaching an AI system what an ‘attack’ looks like, training it on large data lakes of thousands of organizations’ data, Darktrace AI learns from your unique business data to understand what is normal to identify high risk, anomalous activity for each asset across domains. This enables it to detect subtle deviations that signal a threat, including novel and AI-driven cyber-attacks.
